name: familypulse
description: FamilyPulse — collaborative, anticipatory household finance platform (from 'Revolutionizing Household Finance', HCII 2025).

scripts.build: npm run build -w @familypulse/web && npm run build -w @familypulse/api
scripts.test: npm run test -w @familypulse/shared && npm run test -w @familypulse/api && npm run test -w @familypulse/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @familypulse/shared && npm run typecheck -w @familypulse/api && npm run typecheck -w @familypulse/web
